dct_description_sm: The project's overall goal it to classify eco-hydrological micro-sites along a North-South transect of Polar Bear Pass at multiple scales via ground measurements and remote sensing. The project investigates relationships between above-ground phenomena (e.g. vegetation, ground-type) and sub-surface parameters such as moisture content and thaw depth which is critical for accurate estimates of evapotranspiration. In the end the project strives to isolate key surface parameters that allow a classification of eco-hydrological microsites and ideally their upscaling via remote sensing methods from from the plot-scale (< 1m) to the meso (1 m to 10 km) and regional (10km to 100km) scales.
dct_title_s: Remote Sensing Data of Polar Bear Pass, Bathurst Island
